summary: Shows loading variables from external files with vars_files, which keeps sensitive data out of playbooks so they can be shared; each file is a simple YAML dictionary.
questions: How do I load variables from an external file?
How do I keep passwords out of my playbook?
What format is a vars_files file?

answer_card.title: Variables in external files
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: all
  vars:
    favcolor: blue
  vars_files:
    - /vars/external_vars.yml
```

```yaml
# vars/external_vars.yml
somevar: somevalue
password: magic
```

This keeps sensitive values separate so playbooks can go into source control.
